claim: Under the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW), students whose parents' annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 8.00 lakhs per annum are eligible.
evidence: AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW) (a) Supernumerary Seats (b) TFW to 2% of approved seats of program, as per merit. (c) Student’s whose parents annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs 8.00 lakhs per annum will be eligible. (d) Valid Income Certificate issued by the State Authorities only will be accepted.
